newsitem.title: LEBANON: Landmine wounds U.N. peacekeepers in Lebanon.
newsitem.headline: Landmine wounds U.N. peacekeepers in Lebanon.

text.p: Six Irish United Nations peacekeepers were injured when they tripped a landmine during a patrol in southern Lebanon on Saturday, a spokesman for the forces said.
Timor Goksel, spokesman for the U.N. Interim Forces in Lebanon (UNIFIL), told reporters the men were taken to a U.N. hospital in the area by helicopter and two were in serious condition.
Goksel said mines had been planted in the area by Israeli forces two months ago.
"Yesterday (Friday) the Israeli forces and SLA (South Lebanon Army) militia told UNIFIL that the area had been cleared," he said.
The Irish U.N. forces on Friday had cleared four mines from the area and returned there on Saturday to continue their work and then stepped on mines, he added.
